scientific_integrity.known_starting_point: Classical angular Toeplitz Mellin multiplier and qualitative spectral convergence; not claimed as new.
scientific_integrity.new_scope: Unique nondegenerate balancing and explicit sharp exponential concentration deficit with frequency drift.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: Analytic proof supplied with finite numerical corroboration only.

scientific_limitations: Fixed connected angular interval strictly inside the upper half-plane; no endpoint-uniform or multiband result.
Uniqueness holds for weight > -1; the sharp exponent, coefficient and frequency drift are in the limit of weight tending to infinity.
The sharp analytic norm is not attained by nonzero Bergman functions.
Earlier monographs and alternate semiclassical descriptions may contain equivalent results; independent historical verification is absent.
title: Sharp exponential leakage for angular sectors in weighted Bergman spaces
